youtube_description:
Trail mix, dried fruit and coconut water are sold as health foods, but they're high in calories and very easy to eat too much of. Cutting these three snacks is what finally let me lose the last 10 pounds and see my abs. Here's why each one makes you fat, and what I snack on instead.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro17-3-healthy-foods

1. Trail mix: one cup is about 700 calories, more than a Big Mac. It's nuts, raisins and candy sold as a health food.
2. Dried fruit: drying takes the water out and keeps all the sugar. A quarter cup of raisins has about the same sugar as a big bowl of grapes, and it doesn't fill you up.
3. Coconut water: it's sugar water. A one liter carton is about 40 grams of sugar. Drink water and use a zero calorie electrolyte powder instead.

What I snack on instead: sardines, hard boiled eggs, rotisserie chicken and the Chipotle protein cup. They're high in protein, low in carbs and they actually fill you up.
